obras.synopsis_en: After losing her son in an accident, Sol faces her grief while dealing with her in-laws’ funerary rituals. A mysterious presence forces her to confront her greatest fear: it might have been her fault.

obras.synopsis_es: Luego de más de una década viviendo en el exterior, el director regresa a la Argentina para llorar el fallecimiento de su padre, el reconocido artista Jorge Demirjian. Mientras desmantela el estudio de su padre con más de 2.000 obras de arte, se desencadenan viejas heridas familiares.
obras.synopsis_en: After more than a decade living abroad, the director returns to Argentina to mourn the passing of his father, renowned artist Jorge Demirjian. As he dismantles his father's studio of over 2,000 artworks, old family wounds are triggered.
Born to Be Seed

obras.synopsis_es: Ivy, ciudadana de un futuro en decadencia, se ve ahogada en una perpetua melancolía tras separarse de su enamorada. OHM, su asistente robótico y regente del nuevo orden mundial, le presenta la oportunidad única de reencontrarse con ella.
obras.synopsis_en: This is a story set on the future Caribbean coast, which is almost  uninhabitable due to pollution and climate change. Amidst the gloomy landscape of the new world order OHM, we find Ivy, our protagonist, who, after a heartbreaking breakup, is left in a very delicate emotional state.

obras.synopsis_es: Gracias a los chinos por la pólvora, parece que la hubieran hecho para mí. Su invención sucede como un accidente, pensada inicialmente para espantar los espíritus malos. Esta película inicia en China, luego un evento en Cartagena y se acaba siglos después en Bogotá.
obras.synopsis_en: I am grateful to the Chinese for the invention of gunpowder — it feels as if they made it for me. Its discovery happened by accident, originally conceived as a way to ward off evil spirits. This film begins in China, then moves to an event in Cartagena, and ends centuries later in Bogotá.

obras.titulo: Emechiche, El renacer de los cabeciblancos
obras.titulo_original: Emechiche, El renacer de los cabeciblancos
obras.synopsis_en: The Colombian Montes de María are home to the emechiche  (Saguinus oedipus). An endangered species, we will observe their complex relationship with their young and their environment. We will analyse their survival, allowing us to witness their feelings and wild instincts.
obras._busqueda: Emechiche, El renacer de los cabeciblancos

obras.titulo: Pudor ante el asalto de los ojos furtivos
obras.titulo_original: Pudor ante el asalto de los ojos furtivos
obras.synopsis_en: The city as a stage of desire, where the male gaze provokes surveillance and scrutiny of the female body. This power relationship turns the body into a field of contestation in public space.
obras.title_en: Shame in the Face of Furtive Eyes
obras._busqueda: Pudor ante el asalto de los ojos furtivos

obras.synopsis_en: In the mountains of Colombia, Juan, a 13-year-old indigenous peasant boy, is forced to flee from the monster of war. In his escape, between the whistling of bullets and the guidance of his ancestors, he awakens an ancestral power that transforms him into Tuktu: a Taita of extraordinary strength destined to return to sow the peace of the earth.
While dealing with a strange being that lives inside her, a woman seeks to reconcile with her sister over an incident from their adolescence.

obras.synopsis_es: En las llanuras de Colombia, un grupo de mujeres conserva y reinterpreta los lecos, o cantos de trabajo del llano, que durante generaciones fueron interpretados por hombres. A través de sus cantos de vaquería, resignifican su lugar en la tradición llanera, revelando su relación armónica con la naturaleza y su compleja conexión con el arraigo llanero.

obras.titulo: Como el agua, la piedra y la espuma
obras.titulo_original: COMO EL AGUA, LA PIEDRA, Y LA ESPUMA
obras.synopsis_en: A young woman recalls memories of an indigenous person from Nudo de los Pastos, between Ecuador and Colombia, and reflects on the pollution that threatens her land.
obras._busqueda: Como el agua, la piedra y la espuma

obras.synopsis_es: Una comunidad de barequeros y pescadores tienen que aprender a vivir en medio de las consecuencias de un proyecto hidroeléctrico que al inundar las playas del río los obligó a levantar un campamento sobre el cañón del Cauca, desde donde observan un mundo mágico que confirma su tragedia y su destino.

Del olvido y la oscuridad hay imágenes y sonidos que resurgen para controlar los cuerpos de las mujeres latinoamericanas, quienes desde niñas han sido consideradas madres de nacimiento. Pero en estos archivos emerge una interferencia que proviene del pasado para evocar un mensaje de lucha, memoria y libertad.

obras.synopsis_en: In the Medio Atrato region of Chocó, Ana Panesso and her community grow sugarcane and make viche, an ancestral beverage that was once prohibited but now is in vogue. Through food, river trips, and music, viche and its knowledge not only shape people s daily lives but also raise the question of a just future, where viche serves as food, sustenance, and identity for Black families.

Sometimes one, orphaned of one's own lungs, feels that one is drowning.  One suddenly remembers the body, breathes again, and begins to laugh. To laugh very hard. To run around the corners of the world breathing and laughing. Yulieth talks to her mother. She dances. She floats on the water. She laughs.

obras.synopsis_es: Una voz infantil y robótica enumera diferentes aventuras junto a sus particulares mascotas: caracoles. Como si se tratara de un informe científico, lo real y lo fantástico se fusionan en esta historia singular.
obras.synopsis_en: A childish and robotic voice lists different adventures together with its particular pets: snails. As if it were a scientific report, the real and the fantastic merge in this unique story.

obras.synopsis_es: Valentina, una cosmonauta rusa de 76 años, llega a una Cuba ucrónica y nebulosa tras recibir, con treinta años de retraso, una invitación para una expedición agrícola a Marte. Entre paisajes difusos y promesas del pasado, busca las ruinas de un futuro que nunca llegó.

obras.synopsis_en: Between light, metal and silver, a collection of solidarity pins turns into an archive of another scale: spectres of exile and international struggle against Portugal’s fascist and colonial regime.

obras.synopsis_es: Sirena Mecánica es un documental fantástico que desde de los estudios transfeministas reinterpreta el modo en cómo se representa el cuerpo (material y social) femenino dentro del mito de la sirena. Este procedimiento subversivo narra a través de los recuerdos de la primera infancia y los procesos de sanación en la relación intima de la pareja codirectora de la pieza. En el desencuentro con la realidad, SM transita entre paisajes materialmente confusos (fílmicos y plásticos) TRANSitando en la ambigüedad de la protección, amenaza, belleza y violencia.

Una bióloga forense que ha pasado su vida entre fósiles y vitrinas de museos encuentra una foto que lo cambia todo: es su madre, joven, sosteniendo la mirada de una serpiente con una intensidad casi ritual. A partir de ese momento, los reptiles comienzan a infiltrarse en su vida de maneras que no puede ni quiere explicar.
obras.synopsis_en: A taxidermist finds a strange old photograph of her mother with a serpent that will alter her instincts and sensibilities in unpredictable ways.
Kari, an Indigenous girl, is afraid to laugh. But a new interpretation of the old legend of Kiraparamia helps her to set herself free.

obras.synopsis_es: Emma es una niña valiente de 7 años que guarda un importante secreto: le teme a la oscuridad; para ella, allí sus miedos cobran vida. Cuando su abuelo Augusto –un hombre ciego y sabio– descubre su secreto, trama un ingenioso plan para impulsarla a enfrentar sus temores, tejiendo un emotivo vínculo intergeneracional a través del cual Emma explora el poder que se consigue al enfrentar los miedos.

obras.synopsis_en: Sofía, a curious and imaginative young girl, faces challenges at school as she begins to navigate the complexities of her mixed-race identity. As her art springs to life through vibrant and whimsical animations, the story delves into Sofia’s journey of self-discovery, capturing her confusion, resilience, and profound lessons about belonging. Sofia learns to embrace the shades that define her, blending love, culture, and individuality into a unique narrative.
A rescue with a spinning tops, feathers, eggs and friends.

The story follows Kevin, a young man classified as problematic due to his inability to control his impulses. After an incident, Kevin must attend therapy for teenagers, but his father refuses to accompany him. Don Andrés, his stepfather, assumes the role of companion, revealing a relationship that is more fraternal than paternal.

In the middle of the banana-growing area of Urabá, Mairen, an Afro woman, eight months pregnant, goes into labor in an unpopulated area. Although her health is in danger, Mairen, resigned, lies down in a tree to await her fate.

Waldina, the flowers seller of the little town of Arcabuco, has died. Her son Humberto arrives from the big city and decides to make the last delivery of flowers to her clients without knowing that in one of that doors could find his happiness.

In the damp and dusty village of La Hondura, La Mona is ready to sacrifice everything to maintain her authority even if loneliness is the price she must pay. Her body, however, refuses to toe the line.

Simón and Gabo, two 17-year-old best friends, spend the summer with Sam, Gabo's older cousin, an anxious college student seeking to escape her thesis work. They will confront love, friendship, and a malicious giant robot.

obras.synopsis_es: Desde el piso 30 de una torre de cristal, la ciudad de Cali, envuelta en tensión, bulle bajo la mirada de Margot. Cegada por el sol tropical, Margot deambula por la ciudad, ajena a todo lo que la rodea. Lejos de los demás y de su entorno, sus fantasías se funden con la realidad. Su mirada se cruza con la de un hombre en la calle, con el pecho desnudo y los ojos penetrantes. Cada día, Margot sigue al joven, acercándose lentamente al objeto de su deseo.
obras.synopsis_en: From the 30th floor of a glass tower, the city of Cali, gripped by tension, bubbles beneath Margot’s gaze. Blinded by the tropical sun, Margot wanders through the city, oblivious to it all. Far from others and her surroundings, her fantasies merge with reality. Her gaze meets that of a man on the street, his chest bare and his eyes piercing. Every day, Margot follows the young man, slowly drawing closer to the object of her desire.

The last earthquake that struck Popayán in 1983 not only destroyed the Colombian city itself, but left lasting scars on the lives of its men and women that have been inherited by younger generations. Friends María José and Alejandra deal with the traumas of the past and the pain in their own way – through sunsets, art, poetry and cinema itself.

obras.synopsis_es: Mañanitas cuenta la historia de Santiago, un niño de 12 años que se siente ingenuamente atraído por el cuerpo desnudo de Ángela, su prima mayor. Este tímido despertar sexual continúa con un encuentro confuso con otra persona.
obras.synopsis_en: Mañanitas tells the story of Santiago, a 12-year-old boy who is naively attracted to the naked body of Ángela, his older cousin. This timid sexual awakening continues with a confusing encounter with another person.
